headline: Brief v2.1.4-beta — Self-Reliant Agent Guardrails (Zero Random Tabs/Terminals/Other-AI Launches), Local-Time Usage Reset Clock & Ultra-Patient Watching
bullets: Self-Reliant Agent Guardrails (Windows, Linux & Android): Brief thinks, codes, writes, and solves tasks on its own — hard runtime guardrails now block unsolicited Claude/ChatGPT/other-AI launches, random browser tabs, Ctrl+T spam, and stray desktop terminal windows unless you explicitly ask for them.

Usage Reset Clock Below the Top-Right Usage Ring: Shows 'Resetting usage at: <your local time>' right beneath the usage circle and ALWAYS resets usage back to 0% when that local clock time hits — whether you are at 0%, 35%, 99%, or 100%.

Ultra-Patient Stay, Watch & Multi-Permission Engine (Up to 4 Hours, 3–16 Permission Grants): Stays quietly on active processes with wholesome 👀🍿 / 👀🍕 / 👀☕ cursor labels, never spams 'I'm still waiting', and skips false-positive static UI triggers.
Real Post-Completion Testing Across All 4 LLMs (Gemini, OpenAI, Claude & OpenRouter): Verifies files, exit codes, and real outputs before reporting success.

photos.title: Self-Reliant Agent + Local-Time Usage Reset Clock
